BETA Close X Sage Group PLC announced on May 6, 2026, that it purchased 881,944 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of its share buyback program. The purchases occurred at prices ranging from 891.2000 GBp to 924.0000 GBp per share, with a volume-weighted average price of 901.7095 GBp. Sage intends to cancel all acquired shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 06 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 6 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 881,944 Highest price paid per share: 924.0000 Lowest price paid per share: 891.2000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 901.7095 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
